threshold_basis.rule: Fire when Q3 FY2027 TTM normalized owner earnings fall below 14,402 USD millions, the low-case owner-earnings anchor in the frozen contract proof (FY2026 operating cash flow less capital spending per CRM/research/valuation_fact_ledger.json; accession 0001108524-26-000060).

spec.derived_from: Owner earnings, incremental returns, or reinvestment runway fall below the low-case bridge.
spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier for the quality_reinvestment DCF ($145.56 low / $282.00 base / $559.47 high per share on contract hash fd0fdcc2). **[Fact]** The contract locks normalized owner earnings at 14,402 USD millions from FY2026 operating cash flow less capital spending (CRM/research/valuation_fact_ledger.json; CRM/investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260302_rpt20260131_acc0001108524_26_000060.htm). **[Fact]** Q3 FY2026 TTM normalized owner earnings replay at 12,895 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm (OCF TTM minus absolute capex TTM for period ending 2025-10-31; CRM/investor-documents/DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json Q3 filed 2025-12-04). **[Fact]** Q1 FY2027 TTM at 2026-04-30 resolved 14,661 USD millions (10-Q filed 2026-05-28), above the anchor but not the target Q3 FY2027 period. **[Inference]** If Q3 FY2027 TTM resolves below 14,402, the low-case reinvestment bridge is unsupported and per-share value should compress from the $282 base toward the $145.56 low case (roughly 48% component gap). A 28% fire probability reflects that the prior-year Q3 replay already sat below the anchor while CRM continues AI and integration spending, partially offset by the Q1 FY2027 TTM reading above the anchor. Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate inputs remain judgment-only and are not typed here. Target Q3 FY2027 is not observable at registration (information cutoff 2026-09-24).
